description: This file defines the 'OpenClawChatView' SwiftUI view for a chat interface, including UI layout, message handling, and various user interactions for a chat application.

classes.name: OpenClawChatView
classes.description: Main SwiftUI view representing the chat interface with message list, input area, and session management.

classes.name: ChatNoticeCard
classes.description: A view representing a notice or error message card shown in the chat interface.

classes.name: ChatNoticeBanner
classes.description: A banner view for displaying important notices, errors, or information at the top of the chat interface.

methods.name: mergeToolResults
methods.description: Merges tool result messages with previous messages based on tool call IDs.

methods.name: isToolResultMessage
methods.description: Checks if a message is a tool result message based on its role.

methods.name: shouldDisplayMessage
methods.description: Determines if a message should be displayed based on content and UI logic.

methods.name: primaryText
methods.description: Extracts the primary text content from a message.

methods.name: hasInlineAttachments
methods.description: Checks if a message contains inline attachments or files.

methods.name: toolCalls
methods.description: Retrieves tool call contents from a message.

methods.name: inlineToolResults
methods.description: Retrieves inline tool result contents from a message.

methods.name: toolCallIds
methods.description: Collects all tool call IDs associated with a message.

methods.name: toolResultText
methods.description: Gets textual content from a tool result message.

methods.name: dismissKeyboardIfNeeded
methods.description: Dismisses the keyboard on UI interaction, platform-specific.
